Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.

Work Setup

  • Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift
  • Must have a computer/laptop with a webcam
  • Reliable high-speed internet

What You'll Do

  • Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.
  • Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.
  • Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.
  • Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.
  • Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.
  • Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.
  • Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.
  • Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.
  • Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.
  • Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.
  • Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.
  • Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.
  • Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.
  • Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.
  • Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.
  • Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).
  • Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios
  • Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements
  • Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms
  • Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements
  • Advanced Excel
  • Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers
  • Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences
  • Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law
  • Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system
  • Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

Nice to have

•Hands-on experience with Re-Leased

  • Experience preparing outgoings reconciliations forAustralian commercial properties
  • Familiarity with Australian GST on recharges andoutgoings
  • A background spanning both residential and commercialportfolios

Benefits

You’ll be employed by Offshore24/7, placing Filipino professionals with Australian businesses since 2008 —more than 500 placed to date, with a 4.9/5 rating on Glassdoor and 5.0 onGoogle, worth checking before you apply anywhere. You’re on a local Philippineemployment contract with real job security, ongoing training and coaching fromus, and a long-term placement with a stable business rather than project workthat ends.

•100% work from home

  • Full-time, permanent Philippine employment withOffshore 24/7, supporting an established Australian business

•Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM PHT

•13th month pay

•Government-mandated benefits

If you’ve administeredAustralian commercial leases — rent reviews, outgoings and recharges — and youwant a stable long-term role with an established business, apply now.

Havenpark Communities was founded on the mission of creating caring communities for both our residents and employees. Havenpark has a portfolio of 100+ communities and more than 30,000 homesites across the U.S. We are experiencing intentional, rapid growth by continuously acquiring communities.
At Havenpark Communities, our mission is to make caring communities attainable for responsible residents across America. We acquire, improve, and operate manufactured home communities. You may be asking yourself - what makes us different? It is our culture. Our unique culture is fun, rewarding, and inclusive of all. Our five core values guide our everyday behavior: Respect, Grit, Collaboration, Stewardship, and Boldness.

Rent Increase Strategy & Execution

  • Own the annual rent increase process from planning through implementation.
  • Build and manage the renewal and rate-increase calendar across the portfolio.
  • Coordinate timing of increases to align with lease expirations, occupancy goals, and NOI targets.
  • Program and validate approved increases within property management systems.
  • Ensure renewal and increase notices are delivered accurately and within required legal timelines.
  • Monitor retention, delinquency, and post-increase performance metrics to improve future pricing strategy.

Renewal Administration & Compliance

  • Manage the full renewal notice process across all operating states.
  • Ensure all notices meet state-specific requirements for timing, content, delivery, and documentation.
  • Maintain compliance tracking for notice periods, delivery requirements, increase limitations, and required disclosures.
  • Coordinate preparation, execution, and filing of lease renewal documentation.
  • Maintain accurate lease expiration dates, renewal triggers, and resident records within property management systems.
  • Conduct periodic audits to ensure renewal accuracy, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Resident Retention & Non-Renewal Coordination

  • Partner with Community Managers and Regional Vice Presidents to evaluate renewal and non-renewal decisions.
  • Help identify operational or resident experience issues impacting retention.
  • Analyze turnover trends, renewal declines, and retention performance to recommend improvements.
  • Coordinate non-renewal workflows, documentation, and communication processes.
  • Track move-outs, home disposition status, and turnover readiness.
  • Support retention initiatives and renewal strategies that improve occupancy and resident stability.

Reporting, Communication & Process Improvement

  • Maintain reporting related to renewals, rent increases, occupancy, pricing, collections, and retention performance.
  • Provide leadership with regular reporting on renewal acceptance rates, non-renewals, compliance status, and portfolio trends.
  • Conduct regular communication with Community Managers and Regional Vice Presidents regarding upcoming renewals, notice timelines, and operational issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automate workflows, and standardize renewal processes across the portfolio.
  • Stay current on landlord-tenant regulations and manufactured housing compliance requirements across all operating states.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Portfolio Support

  • Partner with onsite and corporate leadership to align renewal execution with portfolio performance goals.
  • Support operational decision-making through renewal performance insights and resident trends.
  • Ensure consistent communication and execution standards across all communities.

Skills & Competencies

  • 3+ years in multifamily, manufactured housing, or residential property management, with direct ownership of renewals, rent increases, or lease administration
  • Strong knowledge of multi-state landlord-tenant law, including state-specific notice periods, delivery requirements, rent increase limitations, and non-renewal procedures
  • Deep understanding of manufactured housing lease structures, lot rent dynamics, and the distinction between resident-owned and community-owned home tenancies
  • Proficiency with property management systems (ManageAmerica preferred) and the ability to program, validate, and audit renewal and rate-increase data
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven workflows across a distributed portfolio
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to evaluate renewal performance data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Clear, professional communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Community Managers, RVPs, legal resources, and corporate leadership

Personal Attributes

  • Highly detail-oriented, compliance-minded, and process-driven, with a strong sense of urgency around deadlines
  • Ownership mindset with a focus on NOI performance, occupancy protection, and measurable financial outcomes
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and making sound judgment calls on non-renewal decisions and resident edge cases
  • Self-directed and organized, capable of managing complex calendars and competing priorities across multiple communities and states

This is not an administrative position. Your primary responsibility is to convert inquiries into property tours, tours into completed applications, and qualified applicants into signed leases. You must be confident speaking with prospects, uncovering their needs, overcoming objections, and clearly communicating why our properties are the right choice.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Conversion and Leasing

  • Respond quickly and professionally to inbound calls, texts, and messages
  • Build rapport with prospects and identify their housing needs
  • Clearly communicate property features, benefits, availability, and next steps
  • Convert qualified inquiries into scheduled property tours
  • Confirm appointments and reduce showing no-shows
  • Follow up with prospects before and immediately after property tours
  • Encourage interested prospects to complete rental applications
  • Address questions and objections that may prevent prospects from applying
  • Guide applicants through the application process and follow up until completion
  • Review applications for completeness before submitting them for approval
  • Maintain accurate notes and track every prospect through the leasing pipeline

Listing Management

Manage and update property listings across platforms such as:

  • Zillow
  • MH Village
  • Trulia
  • HotPads
  • Facebook Marketplace and Groups

Ensure listings are accurate, appealing, current, and optimized to generate qualified inquiries.

Showing Coordination

  • Coordinate with property supervisors to ensure tours occur smoothly and on time
  • Prepare prospects before their scheduled tours
  • Collect feedback from supervisors following each tour
  • Contact prospects promptly after tours while interest is still high
  • Relay updates between prospects and the internal team

Tenant Retention and Growth

  • Manage lease-renewal communications and follow-ups
  • Build positive relationships with current tenants
  • Identify opportunities to convert qualified renters into mobile home owners

Requirements

  • Proven sales, leasing, real estate, or lead-conversion experience
  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Natural, conversational, and confident telephone presence
  • Ability to build trust and rapport quickly
  • Experience overcoming objections and guiding prospects toward a decision
  • Strong follow-up and closing skills
  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple active leads
  • Comfortable being measured against conversion-based KPIs
  • Experience with property-listing platforms is preferred
  • Reliable internet and availability during required U.S. working hours

What Success Looks Like

  • Fast response times
  • High inquiry-to-tour conversion
  • Strong tour-to-application conversion
  • Strong application-to-lease conversion
  • Consistent pre-tour and post-tour follow-up
  • Complete and organized pipeline records
  • No qualified leads slipping through the cracks
  • Increasing occupancy across all properties

Both private customers and more than 40,000 registered vehicle dealers use the platform and benefit from 108 million customer visits per month. As a “one-stop shop”, mobile.de's offering includes financing and leasing solutions in addition to buying and selling - and we will not stop innovating. What we offer

Meaningful Work: We are a diverse, international, highly skilled and passionate team committed to a world where people share more and waste less. Every day you will have the opportunity to make a huge difference for our users, customers as well as shape the future.

Embracing AI: We're at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into our operations. With an AI-first mindset, we foster a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, empowering our team to explore and apply AI in meaningful ways for the company and themselves.

Growth and Development: We are a global organisation who truly believes in growing our people. To support this we offer lots of development and training opportunities and provide a budget for our team members.

Connection and Inclusion: Our culture is the glue that holds us together. We believe in making meaningful connections and creating an inclusive atmosphere with lots of opportunities to connect both in your day to day work and through social team activities (online and offline).

What you’ll do ​& Who you are

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicatedKey Account Manager (d/f/m) Leasingto further develop our leasing sales.

About the role:

As a Key Account Manager Leasing, you will focus on developing sustainable relationships with Germany’s largest dealer groups. Your primary objective will be to drive leasing-specific upselling and cross-selling, growing our influence and market share. You will serve as the voice of the leasing customer, relaying their needs and insights to our internal teams to enhance our offerings. This role reports to the Regional Manager West.

What you'll do:

  • Inspire large dealer groups with a consultative approach to our leasing solutions, positioning our product range as an optimal fit for their leasing needs.

  • Be a strategic partner for major dealer groups in leasing, nurturing long-term account relationships.

  • Establish a sustainable network up to C-level within the leasing sector to achieve medium- and long-term leasing goals.

  • Analyze important leasing performance metrics and develop relevant strategies to ensure sales and corporate leasing goals are met.

  • Monitor leasing market trends and developments, identifying new customer potentials and promising growth opportunities.

  • Translate customer needs and leasing market demands into product recommendations for future development.

  • 2+ years of experience in car sales or key account sales with a customer-focused approach.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert leasing data into actionable insights.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • (Business) Fluent (C1/C2) in German with a good level of English.

  • A strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset, thriving in Sales environments.

  • A passion for delivering outstanding leasing-focused client experiences.

  • Willingness to travel across Germany.

Benefits

Working at mobile.de comes with its perks! Enjoy the following benefits:

  • Recharge with 28 days of paid time off.

  • Stay mobile with a €50 monthly transportation/mobility allowance.

  • Keep growing with a development budget and access to coaching.

  • Family first - enjoy up to 12 (non-birth parent) or 20 (birth parent) weeks of fully paid parental leave.

  • Learn anytime, anywhere with our online and offline library.

  • Get rewarded with an attractive base salary and participation in our annual incentive plans.

  • Work from anywhere - up to 20 days per year from wherever you feel most productive.

About Us

Boundless Life is a family-focused living, working and academy operator building a new model for how families live, their children learn, and parents work around the world. Across eight global destinations — Sintra (Portugal), Syros (Greece), Tuscany (Italy), Andalusia (Spain), Kotor (Montenegro), Bali (Indonesia), Kamakura (Japan), and La Barra (Uruguay) — we offer families the infrastructure to spend one, three, or 6+ months living in a new country: fully furnished homes, dedicated coworking hubs, and our own academy project based learning programs for children ages 1.5 -14.9 years old.

Our members are professionals, entrepreneurs, remote workers, and their families who want their children to grow up as global citizens without pausing their careers or their kids' education. We are asset-light where we can be, hybrid where it makes sense, and long-term partners with our landlords and local communities in every market we enter.

The future of family life and work is global, seamless, and community-driven — and we are building it. Join us as we scale toward our next wave of destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

About The Opportunity

Boundless Life is seeking a highly capable Real Estate Legal Transaction Manager to join our Real Estate & Expansion team and support the growth of our global portfolio across eight active markets today, an active expansion pipeline.

The ideal candidate will bring solid, hands-on experience in commercial real estate legal practice — with a particular focus on complex, multi-jurisdictional lease negotiations and hybrid deal structures (leases with management, operating, or revenue-share components).

This role will serve as a dedicated legal transaction partner to the Real Estate & Expansion team, reporting directly to the General Legal Counsel and working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Global Head of Real Estate, in-house counsel, external local counsel, and business stakeholders across each market. A core focus of the role is the negotiation, drafting, and interpretation of commercial and residential leases, together with all associated ancillary documents — LOIs, addenda, side letters, management agreements, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and building/regulatory authorizations.

Beyond transactional execution, the successful candidate will help build the legal-operational backbone of a fast-growing global platform: standardizing playbooks, coordinating local counsel across jurisdictions, and translating legal risk into commercially usable guidance for the business.

Boundless Life operates across eight very different legal environments — from Portuguese and Spanish commercial lease frameworks to Indonesian Hak Pakai regimes, Italian, Greek, and Montenegrin civil law traditions, and Japanese and Uruguayan market practice — with active expansion pipeline (France, Costa Rica) adding further complexity. Candidates must be comfortable quickly grasping the intricacies of new jurisdictions, working through unfamiliar frameworks with local counsel, and holding the commercial line while doing so.

This position reports to the General Counsel, with a strong working line into the Head of Real Estate & Expansion. Location is flexible (remote-friendly, EMEA time zone preferred), with regular travel expected to active and prospective markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transactional Execution: Lead the drafting and negotiation of a diverse deal flow, including commercial leases (education centers, coworking hubs, family lounges), residential portfolio leases and management agreements, LOIs, MOUs, lease amendments, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and hybrid lease-plus-management structures. Ensure every document protects Boundless Life's commercial and operational interests while unblocking the growth pipeline.
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Coordination: Manage and quality-control external local counsel across our active markets (currently Portugal, Greece, Italy, Spain, Montenegro, Indonesia, Japan, and Uruguay), our active expansion markets (France, Costa Rica), and any new jurisdiction we enter. Own the relationship, the scope, and the output — including translating local legal advice into clear, actionable direction for the business.
  • Asset Management & Operational Support: Provide legal interpretation of the existing lease portfolio and day-to-day support to Operations, Finance, Local Hosts, and Community teams on lease questions, escalations, disputes, permits, and landlord communications.
  • Real Estate Due Diligence: Lead legal due diligence on new locations and strategic initiatives — identifying and pricing regulatory, title, zoning, ERP/permitting, tax withholding, and structural risks — and translating findings into go/no-go recommendations.
  • Playbook & Process Optimization: Help build the RE Legal function from the inside out: templates, redline playbooks by jurisdiction, approval workflows, contract repository standards, and lease management processes. Turn one-off work into repeatable systems.
  • Strategic and Practical Legal Advice: Deliver timely, commercially oriented legal advice to internal stakeholders across all levels — from Development Managers and Project Managers up to the CEO and Board — translating complex legal concepts into clear, risk-based recommendations the business can act on.
  • Dispute Management: Support the resolution of landlord, tenant, and vendor disputes across markets, working with local counsel where litigation, arbitration, or termination scenarios arise.

About You

  • Education: Law degree (JD, LLB, Licenciatura en Derecho, or foreign equivalent) from an accredited institution. LLM or dual-jurisdiction qualification is a plus.
  • Bar Admission: Qualified to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of direct experience in commercial real estate, contract management and leasing practice OR 7 years dealing with high volume complex commercial agreements. A background combining top-tier law firm training with in-house exposure is strongly preferred. Prior experience in hospitality, coliving, education, or multi-jurisdictional real estate portfolios is a significant plus.
  • Languages — Required: Excellent professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written. Comfortable negotiating and drafting complex legal documents in both languages.
  • Languages — Strong Plus: Working proficiency in one or more of: Portuguese, Italian, French, or Japanese. Given the geographic footprint, any additional Boundless Life market language materially improves the fit.
  • Multi-Market Fluency: Demonstrated ability to quickly grasp the intricacies of new legal systems, distinguish market convention from negotiable position, and work effectively with local counsel across civil and common law jurisdictions.
  • Technical Mastery: Proven ability to identify novel and complex legal issues, escalate them appropriately, and translate them into clear, risk-based recommendations for both business and legal stakeholders.
  • Judgement & Ownership: Takes full ownership of work product. Operates effectively and independently with minimal oversight, while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, quality, and efficiency.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional organization and prioritization. Comfortable holding many parallel workstreams — often across multiple time zones and markets — without dropping detail or missing deadlines.
  • Travel: Willing and able to travel regularly (indicatively 15–25% of the time) to active and prospective markets for site visits, negotiations, and closings.
  • Cultural Fit: Collaborative, low-ego, mission-aligned. Comfortable in a fast-paced, ever-evolving scale-up environment where roles stretch, priorities shift, and resilience matters. Believes in what Boundless Life is building for families.
